PublicMultiChoiceBlockSchema.title: PublicMultiChoiceBlockSchema
PublicMultiChoiceBlockSchema.description: Multi-choice block as exposed to a learner (no correct set).

PublicReleaseLessonSchema.title: PublicReleaseLessonSchema
PublicReleaseLessonSchema.description: Lesson projection for the student-facing content tree.

PublicReleaseModuleSchema.title: PublicReleaseModuleSchema
PublicReleaseModuleSchema.description: Module projection for the student-facing content tree.

PublicSingleChoiceBlockSchema.title: PublicSingleChoiceBlockSchema
PublicSingleChoiceBlockSchema.description:
Single-choice block as exposed to a learner.

Carries the question options but NOT the correct id. The
learner submits a choice via the check endpoint; the server
answers ``is_correct`` without leaking the right answer.

PublicTextInputBlockSchema.title: PublicTextInputBlockSchema
PublicTextInputBlockSchema.description:
Text-input block as exposed to a learner.

Accepts the normalisation flags so the SPA can hint at casing
or whitespace expectations; the accepted-answer list itself is
server-side only.

error.title: Error
error.description: Raw class name of the rate-limit error without the trailing `Error` suffix.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of operations allowed in the rolling window before the limit triggers.

retry_after_seconds.title: Retry After Seconds
retry_after_seconds.description: Hint at how long the caller must wait before retrying. Mirrors the standard `Retry-After` HTTP header.

RateLimitedResponseModel.title: RateLimitedResponseModel
RateLimitedResponseModel.description:
Response for actor-scoped rate-limit violations.

Carries the ``limit`` that was hit and ``retry_after_seconds``
so the SPA can render a precise "try again in N hours" message
without parsing free-form text.

release_id.title: Release Id
release_id.description: Target release UUID. Must belong to the same course as the enrollment — releases of other products are rejected as `EntityNotFound`.

email.title: Email
email.description: Login email. Must be a valid address; not unique-checked client-side, but the server returns 409 `EmailAlreadyRegistered` when taken. Max length is 320 characters (`EMAIL_MAX_LEN`).

password.title: Password
password.description: Plain-text password. Length must be in `[12, 128]` (`PASSWORD_MIN_LEN`/`PASSWORD_MAX_LEN`). The server applies additional strength rules and returns 422 `WeakPasswordError` when violated.

first_name.title: First Name
first_name.description: User's given name. Required, non-empty after trimming. Max length is 100 characters (`FIRST_NAME_MAX_LEN`).

last_name.title: Last Name
last_name.description: User's family name. Required, non-empty after trimming. Max length is 100 characters (`LAST_NAME_MAX_LEN`).

patronymic.title: Patronymic
patronymic.description: Optional middle/patronymic name. Omit or pass `null` when not applicable. Max length is 100 characters (`PATRONYMIC_MAX_LEN`).

blocks.title: Blocks
blocks.description: Lesson content blocks ordered by position ascending. Discriminated union over `type`.

ReleaseLessonSchema.title: ReleaseLessonSchema
ReleaseLessonSchema.description:
Lesson projection inside a release tree.

Subclasses :class:`CourseDraftLessonSchema` to inherit shape +
discriminated-union ``blocks`` field. The OpenAPI schema name
is ``ReleaseLessonSchema`` and is rendered separately so SDK
consumers can keep release vs. draft types distinct.

ReleaseModuleSchema.title: ReleaseModuleSchema
ReleaseModuleSchema.description: Module projection inside a release tree.

title.title: Title
title.description: New lesson title. Max length 200 chars.

title.title: Title
title.description: New module title. Max length 200 chars.

ordered_ids.title: Ordered Ids
ordered_ids.description: Full list of lesson ids in the desired order. Must match the existing lesson set of the module exactly.

ordered_ids.title: Ordered Ids
ordered_ids.description: Full list of module ids in the desired order. Must match the existing module set of the course exactly.

ordered_ids.title: Ordered Ids
ordered_ids.description: Full list of block ids inside the lesson in the desired order. Must match the existing block set exactly (any types). HTML, KaTeX and Rutube blocks share one position-space within a lesson.

ordered_ids.title: Ordered Ids
ordered_ids.description: Full ordered list of collage item ids. Must match the block's existing items exactly (same set, no missing or extra ids).

ReorderPhotoCollageItemsSchema.title: ReorderPhotoCollageItemsSchema
ReorderPhotoCollageItemsSchema.description:
Body for ``PUT /courses/{course_id}/blocks/{block_id}/photo-collage/items/order``.

``ordered_ids`` must be a permutation of the block's current
items — no additions, no omissions. Add/remove flows have
their own dedicated endpoints.

position.title: Position
position.description: New sort position within the product's Q&A list, `>= 0`.

email.title: Email
email.description: Address to send the reset link to. The endpoint always returns 204 — existence of an account is intentionally not leaked through the response.

release_id.title: Release Id
release_id.description: UUID of the release whose snapshot will replace the current draft. Must belong to the same course.

ResetCourseDraftSchema.title: ResetCourseDraftSchema
ResetCourseDraftSchema.description:
Body for ``POST /courses/{course_id}/draft/reset``.

Identifies the release whose snapshot the draft should be
rehydrated from. The release must belong to the same course;
otherwise HTTP 404.

token.title: Token
token.description: Single-use reset token delivered by email. Opaque to clients; copy verbatim from the reset link.

new_password.title: New Password
new_password.description: Replacement password. Length must be in `[12, 128]` (`PASSWORD_MIN_LEN`/`PASSWORD_MAX_LEN`). Re-validated against strength rules; 422 `WeakPasswordError` if it fails.

answers.title: Answers
answers.description: All accepted spellings. The SPA can show them as a spectrum (e.g. "Paris" / "paris").

position.title: Position
position.description: Discord-style hierarchy slot. Lower number = higher rank. The product owner has synthetic position `0` (never stored). A caller with `manage_collaborators` may only assign roles with `position` strictly greater than their own highest role's position; the API enforces this and returns 403 `RoleHierarchyViolation` when the rule is broken.

embed_url.title: Embed Url
embed_url.description: Pre-built Rutube URL for an `<iframe>` embed. Computed server-side from `external_id`.

RutubeVideoBlockSchema.title: RutubeVideoBlockSchema
RutubeVideoBlockSchema.description:
Rutube-embed lesson-block projection (read-only).

There is no shared "video" schema — provider-specific embeds
have provider-specific shapes (id format, embed URL template).
Adding a new provider means adding a new ``<Provider>VideoBlockSchema``
and extending the discriminated union below.

``embed_url`` is computed server-side as
``https://rutube.ru/play/embed/{external_id}/`` so the
frontend can drop it into an ``<iframe>`` without knowing
the template.

ScopeType.title: ScopeType
ScopeType.description:
Granularity at which a collaboration grant applies.

``PRODUCT`` covers the whole product (and every module/lesson
inside it). ``MODULE`` covers a single module and all of its
lessons. ``LESSON`` covers a single lesson only.

id.title: Id
id.description: Public session id. Equals the refresh-token family id — the SPA passes it to `DELETE /auth/sessions/{id}` to remotely sign out that specific device.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: When the session was first opened (i.e. when the user logged in on this device). UTC, ISO 8601.

last_used_at.title: Last Used At
last_used_at.description: When the session was last refreshed (rotation moment). Use this as the user-facing 'last activity' timestamp. UTC, ISO 8601.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: When the active refresh cookie naturally dies if no refresh occurs first. UTC, ISO 8601.

ip_address.title: Ip Address
ip_address.description: Best-known originating IP for this session. May be `null` for legacy sessions that pre-date the device-metadata feature, or when the request had no usable client address.

user_agent.title: User Agent
user_agent.description: Raw `User-Agent` header captured at the most recent refresh, truncated to 512 chars. May be `null`. The SPA should prefer `device_label` for display.

device_label.title: Device Label
device_label.description: Short human-readable label parsed from `user_agent` (e.g. `"Chrome on Windows"`). Best-effort; may be `null` when no heuristic matched.

is_current.title: Is Current
is_current.description: `true` when this session matches the refresh cookie sent with the request. The SPA can highlight it as 'this device' and warn before letting the user revoke it.

SessionSchema.title: SessionSchema
SessionSchema.description: One active refresh-token session for the authenticated user.

examples.user_agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 14_5) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/17.5 Safari/605.1.15

kind.description: Network identifier from `SocialLinkKind`. The SPA picks one from the fixed list; choose `other` for misc URLs.

url.title: Url
url.description: Profile URL. Must start with `http://` or `https://`. Max length is 2048 characters.

items.title: Items
items.description: Ordered list of social-link entries that will fully replace the user's current set. The order of the list becomes the persisted `position`. Capped at 32 entries (`SOCIAL_LINKS_MAX_COUNT`).

SimpleErrorResponseModel.title: SimpleErrorResponseModel
SimpleErrorResponseModel.description:
Default response model used when no translator is provided.

Can also be used in custom translators:

    >>> class MyTranslator(ErrorTranslator[SimpleErrorResponseModel]):
    ...     def from_error(self, err: Exception) -> SimpleErrorResponseModel:
    ...         return SimpleErrorResponseModel(error="...")
    ...
    ...     @property
    ...     def error_response_model_cls(self) -> type[SimpleErrorResponseModel]:
    ...         return SimpleErrorResponseModel

Produces: {"error": "..."}

correct_option_id.title: Correct Option Id
correct_option_id.description: Id of the option the student must pick. Always one of `options[*].oid`. Authors only — stripped from the release-side public view sent to learners.

SingleChoiceBlockSchema.title: SingleChoiceBlockSchema
SingleChoiceBlockSchema.description:
Single-choice answer block projection (authoring-side, read-only).

The question prompt itself is NOT part of this block — it lives
in a preceding HTML block. This schema carries only the answer
field configuration. ``correct_option_id`` is included because
this projection is for authors; the student-facing public view
drops it (see release-content endpoints).

SocialLinkKind.title: SocialLinkKind
SocialLinkKind.description:
Recognised social-network kinds for a user's public profile.

The enum keeps the kind list closed at the domain boundary so the
frontend can ship per-kind icons / colors without guessing from URL
patterns. ``OTHER`` is the escape hatch for less common platforms
— the SPA renders a generic globe icon for it.

kind.description: Network identifier from `SocialLinkKind`. Drives icon selection on the public profile.

url.title: Url
url.description: Profile URL. Must start with `http://` or `https://`. Max length is 2048 characters (`SOCIAL_LINK_URL_MAX_LEN`).

position.title: Position
position.description: Server-assigned 0-based position used to render the list in the order the user saved it.

SocialLinkSchema.title: SocialLinkSchema
SocialLinkSchema.description: A single social-network link on the user's public profile.

plan_code.title: Plan Code
plan_code.description: Plan the author was on when enforcement ran.

deleted_files_count.title: Deleted Files Count
deleted_files_count.description: Number of files soft-deleted in this enforcement pass. Picked newest-first across the author's courses; files referenced from older blocks are preserved when the freed total reaches the overage.

freed_bytes.title: Freed Bytes
freed_bytes.description: Total size in bytes of the soft-deleted files. May exceed the overage at detection time — the loop stops at the first file whose inclusion crosses the cap.

StorageQuotaEnforcedDetailsSchema.title: StorageQuotaEnforcedDetailsSchema
StorageQuotaEnforcedDetailsSchema.description:
Body of a ``storage_quota_enforced`` notification.

Sent after the grace period expired and the reconcile job
soft-deleted the overflow. The card is informational — files
in the DB are flagged ``deleted_at != NULL`` and the
S3-purge worker physically removes the blobs. Recovery is a
support flow while the rows still exist.

plan_code.title: Plan Code
plan_code.description: Plan of the author at the moment the breach was detected. Stable token (``FREE`` / ``BETA`` / ...).

over_bytes.title: Over Bytes
over_bytes.description: How many bytes above the plan cap the author was at detection. Drifts over time as the author uploads / deletes; treat as historical.

grace_until.title: Grace Until
grace_until.description: ISO 8601 timestamp (UTC) — after this point the next reconcile pass soft-deletes the overflow newest-first until the author is back under cap. Computed as ``detected_at + OVER_QUOTA_GRACE_PERIOD_DAYS`` and stable for the lifetime of the breach.

StorageQuotaWarningDetailsSchema.title: StorageQuotaWarningDetailsSchema
StorageQuotaWarningDetailsSchema.description:
Body of a ``storage_quota_warning`` notification.

Emitted by the daily reconcile job when an author's used bytes
first exceed their plan cap. The SPA renders a card like
"You are over the FREE 2 GB cap by 1.4 GB. Free up space or
upgrade before <grace_until> or we will delete the most
recently uploaded files." All four numbers are a **snapshot at
detection** — for live state the SPA falls back to
``GET /users/me/subscription``.

storage_bytes.title: Storage Bytes
storage_bytes.description: Total bytes used across the caller's own courses.

StorageUsageSchema.title: StorageUsageSchema
StorageUsageSchema.description: Aggregate storage consumption for the caller.

TagSchema.title: TagSchema
TagSchema.description: Tag response projection — the same shape on every tag-emitting endpoint.

accepted_answers.title: Accepted Answers
accepted_answers.description: Author-provided list of accepted answers. Comparison happens at check-time under the block's own normalisation flags. Max 10 entries (`TEXT_INPUT_MAX_ACCEPTED`), each up to 500 chars (`TEXT_INPUT_ANSWER_MAX_LEN`). Authors only.

case_sensitive.title: Case Sensitive
case_sensitive.description: If true, the student's answer must match casing exactly.

trim_whitespace.title: Trim Whitespace
trim_whitespace.description: If true, surrounding whitespace is stripped from both sides before comparison.

TextInputBlockSchema.title: TextInputBlockSchema
TextInputBlockSchema.description:
Free-text answer block projection (authoring-side, read-only).

Like the choice schemas, this exposes the accepted answers
because the projection is for authors. The student-facing
public view drops the answer list.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.description: Purpose the token was issued for. Mirrors `EmailTokenPurpose` values.

token.title: Token
token.description: Single-use token delivered by email. The endpoint peeks at the token without consuming, so the SPA can render a form (e.g. password-reset) only when the link is still live.

tabs.title: Tabs
tabs.description: Full new tabs list — replaces the existing one.

UpdateCodeBlockSchema.title: UpdateCodeBlockSchema
UpdateCodeBlockSchema.description:
Body for ``PATCH /courses/{course_id}/blocks/{block_id}/code``.

Replaces the entire tabs list. Partial / per-tab updates are
intentionally not supported — see :class:`UpdateCodeBlockCommand`.

description.title: Description
description.description: New module description, or `null` to clear. Max length 5000 chars.

UpdateCourseModuleDescriptionSchema.title: UpdateCourseModuleDescriptionSchema
UpdateCourseModuleDescriptionSchema.description:
Body for ``PATCH /courses/{course_id}/modules/{module_id}/description``.

Send ``null`` to clear the description.

grants.title: Grants
grants.description: Replacement grant set. Must contain at least one entry.

html.title: Html
html.description: New raw HTML body. Sanitized server-side; max length 50000 chars after sanitization. Empty payload is accepted (clears the body).

source.title: Source
source.description: New KaTeX source body. Max length 50000 chars. Empty payload is accepted (clears the source).

options.title: Options
options.description: Full new option list — replaces the existing one.

caption.title: Caption
caption.description: New caption text, or `null` to clear. Max 280 chars (`PHOTO_COLLAGE_CAPTION_MAX_LEN`).

UpdatePhotoCollageItemCaptionSchema.title: UpdatePhotoCollageItemCaptionSchema
UpdatePhotoCollageItemCaptionSchema.description:
Body for the per-item caption PATCH endpoint.

``caption`` is the new caption value, or ``null`` to clear.

title.title: Title
title.description: New collage title, or `null` to clear. Max 200 chars (`BLOCK_TITLE_MAX_LEN`).

UpdatePhotoCollageTitleSchema.title: UpdatePhotoCollageTitleSchema
UpdatePhotoCollageTitleSchema.description: Body for the photo-collage title PATCH endpoint.

items.title: Items
items.description: Ordered list of tags to attach. Up to `5` items per product (`PRODUCT_TAGS_MAX`). Each item is either a reference to an existing tag (`tag_id`) or a new `{name, color}` pair the server upserts by slug.

UpdateProductTagsSchema.title: UpdateProductTagsSchema
UpdateProductTagsSchema.description:
Body for ``PUT /products/{product_id}/tags``.

Replaces the product's tag set in one shot. Each item is
either an existing tag id or a new ``{name, color}`` pair —
the SPA does not have to make a separate "create tag" call
before attaching. Duplicates within ``items`` collapse to the
first occurrence; the list ordering survives storage.

value.title: Value
value.description: New progress percentage in `[0, 100]`. Setting `100` automatically marks the enrollment completed (sets `completed_at` on the course details body; does not change `status`).

name.title: Name
name.description: New role name. `null` means leave unchanged. Length `1..100`.

description.title: Description
description.description: New description. `null` plus `clear_description=true` clears it explicitly; `null` alone leaves the existing value untouched. Max length `1000`.

clear_description.title: Clear Description
clear_description.description: Set to `true` together with `description=null` to explicitly clear the description.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: Replacement permission set. `null` means leave unchanged. Must contain at least one entry when set.

UpdateRoleSchema.title: UpdateRoleSchema
UpdateRoleSchema.description:
Body for ``PATCH /roles/{role_id}``.

All fields are optional. ``description`` uses two fields together
to distinguish "leave as-is" (`null`) from "explicitly clear"
(`clear_description=true`).

rutube_url.title: Rutube Url
rutube_url.description: New Rutube video URL — must match the same format as add.

title.title: Title
title.description: New caption, or `null` to clear. Max length 200 chars.

UpdateRutubeVideoBlockSchema.title: UpdateRutubeVideoBlockSchema
UpdateRutubeVideoBlockSchema.description:
Body for ``PATCH /courses/{course_id}/blocks/{block_id}/rutube-video``.

``rutube_url`` is required. ``title`` is required to be set
explicitly: ``null`` clears the caption, a string sets it.

options.title: Options
options.description: Full new option list — replaces the existing one.

UpdateSingleChoiceBlockSchema.title: UpdateSingleChoiceBlockSchema
UpdateSingleChoiceBlockSchema.description:
Body for ``PATCH /courses/{course_id}/blocks/{block_id}/single-choice``.

Replaces the entire option list. Per-option partial updates are
intentionally unsupported — see ``UpdateSingleChoiceBlockCommand``.

accepted_answers.title: Accepted Answers
accepted_answers.description: Full new accepted-answer list — replaces the existing one.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline for the entry — typically the role or program name. Required, non-empty after trimming. Max length is 200 characters (`TITLE_MAX_LEN`).

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional free-text description. `null` to clear the field. Max length is 1000 characters (`DESCRIPTION_MAX_LEN`).
examples: Lead the redesign of the editor flow.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Day the experience started (ISO 8601 calendar date).

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Day the experience ended, or `null` for ongoing entries. Must not precede `start_date`.

source_url.title: Source Url
source_url.description: Optional external link (must start with `http://` or `https://`). `null` clears it. Max length is 2048 characters (`SOURCE_URL_MAX_LEN`).

UpdateUserExperienceSchema.title: UpdateUserExperienceSchema
UpdateUserExperienceSchema.description:
Body for `PUT /users/me/experiences/{experience_id}`.

Replaces every editable field. Send `null` for ``description``,
``end_date`` or ``source_url`` to clear those fields. The icon
is managed separately via the icon endpoints, so it is not part
of this payload.

oid.title: Oid
oid.description: Server-generated UUID of the newly stored file.

UploadedFileSchema.title: UploadedFileSchema
UploadedFileSchema.description:
Confirmation envelope returned by file-upload endpoints.

Carries only the freshly-created file's id. The full
:class:`FileSchema` with presigned URL is delivered by the parent
resource (avatar / cover lives on :class:`UserSchema`, product
cover on :class:`ProductSchema`, etc.) — the client should
refetch that resource after upload rather than locking onto a
URL the upload response would have to sign in advance.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline for the entry. Max length is 200 characters (`TITLE_MAX_LEN`).

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional free-text description, or `null` when not set. Max length is 1000 characters (`DESCRIPTION_MAX_LEN`).
examples: Lead the redesign of the editor flow.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Day the experience started (ISO 8601 calendar date).

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Day the experience ended, or `null` for ongoing entries.

source_url.title: Source Url
source_url.description: Optional external link, or `null` when not set. Max length is 2048 characters (`SOURCE_URL_MAX_LEN`).

icon.description: Resolved icon file with a short-lived presigned URL, or `null` when no icon is attached. The URL expires; re-fetch the list to get a fresh one.

UserExperienceSchema.title: UserExperienceSchema
UserExperienceSchema.description:
A single experience entry on a user's profile.

Returned in the catalogue order (most recent ``start_date``
first) by `GET /users/{user_id}/experiences`.

examples.description: Lead the redesign of the editor flow.
examples.title: Product Designer at Spherule

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: User identifier whose presence is reported.

status.description: Current presence status. `online` means the user has at least one live session; `offline` means none.

UserPresenceSchema.title: UserPresenceSchema
UserPresenceSchema.description:
Response of `GET /presence/{user_id}`.

Carries a per-user snapshot — `status` is `online` if at least one
of the user's sessions has refreshed its heartbeat within the
server-side TTL, otherwise `offline`.

full_name.title: Full Name
full_name.description: Display name in the canonical Russian-style `Last First Patronymic` order. Whitespace-trimmed; missing patronymic collapses to `Last First`.

email.title: Email
email.description: Privacy-respecting masked address in the form `f*****d@domain.com` — the first and last characters of the local part are preserved, everything in between collapses to a fixed asterisk run, and the domain stays intact. Use it for display only; never echo it back as login input. May be an empty string in the rare placeholder case where the reader could not join the underlying user row — the SPA must tolerate this and fall back to ``full_name`` for display.

UserRefSchema.title: UserRefSchema
UserRefSchema.description:
Unified user reference embedded in parent resources.

Returned wherever the API exposes a user *as a reference inside
another resource* — product author, collaboration collaborator,
notification actor, and so on. Carries the user's identifier, the
canonical ``Last First Patronymic`` display name, and a
privacy-masked email so the SPA can render the row without a
follow-up ``GET /users/{id}``.

Distinct from :class:`UserSchema`, which is the full profile
projection (``GET /users/{id}``) and adds avatar, cover, and
description on top of these fields. Distinct from
:class:`UserSummarySchema`, which intentionally omits ``email``
to keep the public name-search endpoint immune to address
enumeration.

full_name.title: Full Name
full_name.description: Display name in the canonical Russian-style `Last First Patronymic` order. Whitespace-trimmed; missing patronymic collapses to `Last First`.

email.title: Email
email.description: Privacy-respecting masked address in the form `f*****d@domain.com` — the first and last characters of the local part are preserved, everything in between collapses to a fixed asterisk run, and the domain stays intact. Use it for display only; never echo it back as login input.

is_verified.title: Is Verified
is_verified.description: Whether the platform has granted the user the public "verified" badge — surfaced as a brand-coloured checkmark on the avatar across the SPA. Distinct from `email_verified`, which only tracks login-email confirmation and is not surfaced through this API.

description.title: Description
description.description: User-authored profile description as sanitized HTML. `null` when the user has not set one. The server sanitizes the markup before storage; clients can render the value directly.

avatar.description: Resolved avatar file with a short-lived presigned URL, or `null` when no avatar is attached. The URL expires; re-fetch the user resource to get a fresh one.

cover.description: Resolved cover image with a short-lived presigned URL, or `null` when no cover is attached. The URL expires; re-fetch the user resource to get a fresh one.

website_url.title: Website Url
website_url.description: User-supplied personal website URL, or `null` when not set. Always an absolute `http(s)` URL within 2048 characters (`WEBSITE_URL_MAX_LEN`).

portfolio_url.title: Portfolio Url
portfolio_url.description: User-supplied portfolio URL, or `null` when not set. Always an absolute `http(s)` URL within 2048 characters (`PORTFOLIO_URL_MAX_LEN`).

public_email.title: Public Email
public_email.description: User-supplied public contact email, or `null` when not set. Distinct from the login email — surfaced un-masked because the user explicitly opted in to publishing it. Max length is 320 characters (`PUBLIC_EMAIL_MAX_LEN`).

UserSchema.title: UserSchema
UserSchema.description:
Public user profile.

The user's identity is exposed as a single ``full_name`` string
(``Last First Patronymic``) plus a ``email`` masked through the
canonical ``f*****d@domain.com`` form so the API never returns a
plain address. ``avatar`` / ``cover`` are nested :class:`FileSchema`
objects with presigned URLs baked in — no follow-up file-fetch
endpoint needed.

full_name.title: Full Name
full_name.description: Display name in the canonical Russian-style `Last First Patronymic` order. Whitespace-trimmed; missing patronymic collapses to `Last First`.

is_verified.title: Is Verified
is_verified.description: Whether the platform has granted the user the public "verified" badge — surfaced as a brand-coloured checkmark on the avatar across the SPA.

avatar.description: Resolved avatar file with a short-lived presigned URL, or `null` when no avatar is attached. The URL expires; re-issue the search to get a fresh one.

UserSummarySchema.title: UserSummarySchema
UserSummarySchema.description:
Lightweight user projection returned by name search.

Like :class:`UserSchema` it omits ``description`` — the search
endpoint is general-purpose, so private fields stay private.
``cover_url`` is also omitted because callers display a single
thumbnail per hit, not a full profile card. ``email`` is **not**
surfaced at all here, even masked, because the search endpoint
must not let an attacker enumerate registered addresses.

VapidKeySchema.title: VapidKeySchema
VapidKeySchema.description:
Public VAPID identifier handed to the browser at subscribe-time.

The ``public_key`` is the URL-safe Base64 encoding of the raw
P-256 EC point; the SPA decodes it to a ``Uint8Array`` and
passes it to ``PushManager.subscribe`` as
``applicationServerKey``.

token.title: Token
token.description: Single-use verification token delivered by email. The token is opaque to clients; copy it verbatim from the verification link's query string.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.description: Purpose the token was issued for. Mirrors `EmailTokenPurpose` values (`verify`, ...). The SPA may use this to pick localized success copy or to choose a post-confirm redirect.

token.title: Token
token.description: Single-use token delivered by email. Opaque to clients; copy verbatim from the confirmation link's query string.

VerifyTokenSchema.title: VerifyTokenSchema
VerifyTokenSchema.description:
Body for `POST /auth/verify-token`.

Used by the unified ``/confirm/<purpose>`` SPA page to consume any
routable single-token email confirmation in one call. The handler
looks up ``purpose`` from the token itself; the SPA does not need
to declare it.

VideoFileBlockSchema.title: VideoFileBlockSchema
VideoFileBlockSchema.description:
Uploaded-video lesson-block projection.

Sibling of :class:`RutubeVideoBlockSchema` — same playback
intent, different provider. The nested :class:`FileSchema`
carries a short-lived presigned URL the SPA's video player
can plug straight into ``<video src>`` (or our
:class:`VideoPlayer` wrapper).

WebPushSubscribeRequest.title: WebPushSubscribeRequest
WebPushSubscribeRequest.description:
Body of ``POST /users/me/web-push/subscriptions``.

Mirrors the structure browsers hand to ``PushSubscription
.toJSON()`` so the frontend can post it almost as-is. Keys are
URL-safe Base64 strings emitted by the browser; we do not
re-encode them.

message.title: Message
message.description: Human-readable welcome string. Stable for monitoring.

refreshCookie.description: HttpOnly cookie scoped to `/auth/refresh`. Sent automatically by browsers when calling `POST /auth/refresh` or `POST /auth/logout`.
refreshCookie.name: refresh_token

accessCookie.description: HttpOnly cookie issued by `POST /auth/login` (or by `GET /auth/email-verification/wait` once the email is confirmed). Sent automatically by browsers on every request to a protected endpoint.
accessCookie.name: access_token

signupSessionCookie.description: HttpOnly cookie scoped to `/auth`. Issued by `POST /auth/register` and consumed by `GET /auth/email-verification/wait` to auto-login the same browser tab once the user clicks the verification link.
signupSessionCookie.name: signup_session

tags.name: Root
tags.description: Liveness and welcome endpoints. Not protected and not intended for SPA consumption — present so deployment tooling (Docker, Caddy) has something to probe.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Registration, login, token rotation, logout, email verification, and password reset. All session state is kept in HttpOnly cookies; the SPA never touches a token directly.

tags.name: Users
tags.description: User profile reads and edits. `GET /users/{user_id}` is public; everything under `/users/me/...` requires the `accessCookie` security scheme.

tags.name: Billing
tags.description: Caller-scoped subscription read — current plan, plan limits, and aggregate storage usage. Plans live in code (`learnic/entities/billing/plan.py`); the DB carries only `(user_id, plan_code, ...)` grant rows. Absence of an active grant means the caller is on the in-code default plan (`FREE`). Quota enforcement on file-backed block creation surfaces as HTTP 413 `StorageQuotaExceeded` — the response body carries `plan_code`, `used_bytes`, `attempted_bytes`, and `limit_bytes` so the SPA can render an actionable message.

tags.name: UserSocialLinks
tags.description: Public list of social-network links per user — `(kind, url)` pairs displayed on the public profile alongside website / portfolio / public email. `GET /users/{user_id}/social-links` is public; `PUT /users/me/social-links` atomically replaces the caller's list (order of `items` becomes the persisted `position`, capped at `SOCIAL_LINKS_MAX_COUNT`).

tags.name: UserExperiences
tags.description: Per-user work / study timeline entries — icon, dates, title, description, optional source URL. `GET /users/{user_id}/experiences` is public; everything under `/users/me/experiences/...` requires the `accessCookie` scheme and mutates only the caller's own rows (HTTP 403 `NotResourceOwner` otherwise). The icon is managed through dedicated `POST` / `DELETE` `/users/me/experiences/{experience_id}/icon` endpoints.

tags.name: Products
tags.description: User-owned learning products — courses and webinars. `GET /products` (catalog) and `GET /products/{id}` are public; `POST /products/courses`, `POST /products/webinars`, `GET /products/mine`, all PATCH/POST/DELETE state-changing endpoints, require the `accessCookie` scheme. Mutations are author-only; non-owners get HTTP 403 `NotResourceOwner`. Drafts can be deleted; published or archived products must be archived first (HTTP 409 `ProductNotInDraft`). Real-time deltas of product metadata and Q&A flow over `WS /products/{product_id}/events`; live editor cursors flow over `WS /products/{product_id}/cursors` — see the **WebSocket channels** section in the API description.

tags.name: Cohorts
tags.description: Webinar cohorts — concrete streams of a webinar product. `GET /cohorts/{id}` and `GET /products/{id}/cohorts` are public; mutations require the `accessCookie` scheme and are restricted to either the parent product's author or the cohort's `host_id` (HTTP 403 `NotResourceOwner` otherwise). `POST /products/{id}/cohorts` requires a webinar product (HTTP 409 `NotAWebinar` for courses).

tags.name: WebinarSchedules
tags.description: Recurring schedules attached to a cohort. Adding or updating a schedule kicks off a TaskIQ-driven materialisation that expands the rrule into concrete `WebinarSession` rows. The materialisation is incremental — past sessions are not retroactively rewritten on update; the worker resumes from the last `original_starts_at` cursor. Mutations follow the same host-or-author authorisation as cohorts.

tags.name: WebinarSessions
tags.description: Concrete materialised sessions of a cohort, plus manual one-offs. `GET` endpoints are public; mutations (reschedule, cancel, complete, attach/remove recording, change stream URL) follow the same host-or-author authorisation as cohorts.

tags.name: Enrollments
tags.description: Student enrollments — currently course-only. Polymorphic on `kind` (`course`); the kind-specific body lives in `details` (course: `release_id`, `progress_percent`, `completed_at`). `product_id` and `student_id` live on the base shape. `status` has two values: `active` (default) and `revoked` (author/admin removal of access). Course completion lives on `details.completed_at` and is orthogonal to `status` — a completed enrollment is still `active`. Create: `POST /products/{product_id}/enrollments` (self-enroll; product must be `PUBLISHED` — 409 `CannotEnrollInUnpublishedProduct` otherwise; 409 on `ProductDoesNotSupport`, `AlreadyEnrolled`, or `CannotEnrollInUnreleasedCourse`). Admin grants live on an internal handler and do not expose an HTTP route. Caller-scoped: `GET /users/me/enrollments`. List by parent: `GET /courses/{course_id}/enrollments` (author/`READ_PRODUCT`). Item ops: `PATCH /courses/{course_id}/enrollments/{id}/progress` is student-only and auto-marks-completed at 100; `/complete` is author-only.

tags.name: CourseReleases
tags.description: Immutable releases of a course product. A release snapshots the current draft (modules + lessons + blocks) into mirror tables, pinning every row to the new release id. Creating the **first** release also flips the product's status to ``PUBLISHED`` — courses are not published any other way (the standalone publish endpoint refuses for courses with HTTP 409 ``CannotPublishCourseDirectly``). Versions follow semver: from the previous ``v(M.m.p)``, ``patch`` → ``v(M.m.p+1)``, ``minor`` → ``v(M.m+1.0)``, ``major`` → ``v(M+1.0.0)``. The first release starts from the implicit baseline ``v0.0.0``. All endpoints under this tag are author-only.

tags.name: CourseContent
tags.description: Author-side editing of course content — modules and lessons inside a course product. All endpoints under `/products/{product_id}/...` and `/products/{product_id}/lessons/...` require the `accessCookie` scheme and are author-only (HTTP 403 `NotResourceOwner` otherwise). Operations refuse on webinar products with HTTP 409 `NotACourse`. Content lives in the product's draft workspace; releases are introduced in a later phase and snapshot the draft. Real-time deltas of course-content edits flow over the unified product channel `WS /products/{product_id}/events` — see the **WebSocket channels** section in the API description.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Globally-shared name + color labels attachable to any product. Tags are append-only and not author-scoped: any authenticated user can search the pool, and any user with `edit_description` on a product can attach existing tags or mint new ones via the get-or-create branch of `PUT /products/{product_id}/tags`. Dedup happens by `slug` (lower-cased, whitespace-collapsed `name`); two clients typing the same tag converge on the same row. Color is owned by the first creator and stored canonical-hex (validated by `pydantic_extra_types.color.Color`); per-product overrides are intentionally not supported. Real-time deltas of a product's tag list flow over the product channel `WS /products/{product_id}/events` as `tags_changed` — see the **WebSocket channels** section in the API description.

tags.name: Roles
tags.description: Per-product role catalogue used by collaboration grants. Two system roles (Commentor, Editor) are seeded by Alembic and visible inside every product. Custom roles live inside a single product and are managed by collaborators with `manage_roles` (HTTP 403 `InsufficientPermissions` otherwise). Deleting a role still referenced by any grant returns HTTP 409 `RoleInUse` — reassign collaborators first. Permissions carry implicit dependencies (e.g. `edit_modules` implies `edit_lessons`); the authoriser expands them at check time, so the persisted permission set may be smaller than the effective one.

tags.name: Collaborations
tags.description: Multi-user collaboration on products. Each collaboration carries a list of grants `(role, scope, scope_id?)` where scope is `product` / `module` / `lesson`; resolved permissions are the union of every grant whose scope covers the requested target, expanded through the permission-implication graph. The product author is short-circuited as having every permission and cannot be invited as a collaborator. Two invite paths: `POST /products/{id}/collaborations/by-user` for already-registered users, `POST /products/{id}/collaborations/by-email` for (possibly) unregistered ones — both produce a `PENDING_INVITE` row and email a link of the shape `/products/{product_id}/collaboration-invitation/{collaboration_id}/accept?token=...`. The SPA bounces unauthenticated users through `/login?next=...` and POSTs the token to `POST /collaborations/{id}/accept-by-token`. All collaborator-side notifications (invite, accept, revoke, grant change, self-leave) are delivered by email. Real-time deltas of the collaborator list flow over the product channel `WS /products/{product_id}/events` to anyone with `read_product` (every collaborator) — see the **WebSocket channels** section in the API description for the full kind list and payload semantics.

tags.name: Presence
tags.description: Online-status reads and live push. `GET /presence/{user_id}` answers a one-off query. `WS /presence/ws` is a long-lived WebSocket: holding it open marks the connecting user online; the client subscribes to user ids of interest and receives `snapshot` (initial state) and `presence` (deltas) push messages. Both endpoints reuse the standard `accessCookie` security scheme. The WebSocket protocol is documented in full in the **WebSocket channels** section of the API description above (OpenAPI 3 does not model WebSockets, so the contract lives there as prose).

tags.name: Notifications
tags.description: In-app notification panel for the bell icon. `GET /users/me/notifications` returns a cursor-paginated list, optionally filtered by tab (`?category=teaching|learning|security|files|jobs|other`). `GET /users/me/notifications/counters` returns per-tab totals + unread for the segmented control and the bell badge. `POST /users/me/notifications/{id}/read` flips one card to read; `POST /users/me/notifications/read-all` is the double-check icon. Real-time deltas (new card, single-read, read-all) flow over `WS /users/me/notifications` — see the **WebSocket channels** section in the API description.

tags.name: Wallet
tags.description: Per-user money holder. `GET /users/me/wallet` returns available + pending totals; `GET /users/me/wallet/ledger` returns the immutable journal of every credit and debit. All amounts are in **minor units** (kopecks for RUB) — see the *Money / minor units* section in the API description for the convention and rationale.

tags.name: Orders
tags.description: Purchases of paid products. `POST /products/{id}/purchase` charges the caller's wallet and freezes the author's and platform's shares until the refund window closes. `POST /users/me/orders/{id}/refund` reverses the order while both freezes are still in `frozen` state — once either is released by the worker, the refund window has closed and the buyer is redirected to support.

tags.name: Dev
tags.description: Development-only endpoints, registered only when `APP_ENVIRONMENT=development`. Bypass the missing payment integration: `POST /dev/wallet/topup` credits the caller's own wallet; `POST /dev/freezes/release-now` runs the release worker synchronously instead of waiting for the next scheduler tick. Absent from prod builds.
